## Corporate Strategy Continues to Focus on Financial Services Sector


SAN CLEMENTE, CA.


- November 23, 2026


The Marygold Companies, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE American: MGLD), a diversified global holding firm with a focus on financial services, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Gourmet Foods Limited, has completed the previously announced sale of its subsidiary Printstock Products Limited to TAG Investments Limited, a New Zealand-based private investment firm, in a cash transaction.


The transaction was structured as an asset sale, with a purchase price of NZ$2.45 million, (approximately US$1.3 million), subject to potential post-closing adjustments. Gourmet Foods acquired Printstock Products during 2020 as a wholly owned subsidiary, and has operated it profitably since then. New ownership intends to continue operations uninterrupted, with essentially the same staff and practices. Printstock, located in Napier, New Zealand, is a printer of specialized food wrappers.


**About The Marygold Companies, Inc.**


The Marygold Companies, Inc. was founded in 1996 and repositioned as a global holding firm in 2015. The Company currently has operating subsidiaries in financial services, food manufacturing, and beauty products, under the trade names USCF Investments, Marygold & Co., Step-By-Step Financial Planners, Marygold & Co. Limited, Gourmet Foods, and Original Sprout, respectively. Offices and manufacturing operations are in the U.S., New Zealand, and the U.K. For more information, visit[www.themarygoldcompanies.com](http://www.themarygoldcompanies.com/) .
